scenario.summary: Signed in: pastes every row of the multiple-products table ('<sku> , <qty>') into the Add Multiple Items box, adds them to the quick list and the cart, and checks the cart has one line per row, then empties the cart.
steps: Open the webstore and sign in
Quick Order, Add Multiple Items, Paste Multiple
Paste one '<ProductSku> , <ProductQuantity>' line per row of multipleValidProductsAndTheirQuantity; Add All to Quick List; verify message box
Verify cart line item count = number of rows
stateChanges: Account cart: the products added, then removed
assertions: Cart line item count equals the number of pasted rows
evidence: Independent method (priority 110, no dependsOn): it opens the webstore itself and clears the quick list / cart at the end, so it declares its own needs.

Read by the page object, not scanned: QuickOrderPadPage.addMultipleProductsInAddMultipleItemsBox reads table multipleValidProductsAndTheirQuantity (TestDataConstants.TEST_DATA_QUICK_ORDER_MULTIPLE_PRODUCTS_DATA, sheet quickOrderPage) rows product0..product<N-1>, columns ProductSku and ProductQuantity. It pastes '<ProductSku> , <ProductQuantity>' for every row; the test expects quickOrderMultipleProductsDataMap.size() cart lines. No source entries: the cells are not in any scan and the workbook is not read. Table position: quickOrderPasteMultipleSkusPageData data rows end at 31, so the table starts after row 31; its row count is unknown (at least 2: multipleProductsCountToBeAdded = 2 reads product0 and product1). ASSUMPTION (needs review): two rows; the migrated test loops over the declared needs.
Quantities: ProductQuantity is not scanned (config); ASSUMPTION: the migrated test pastes quantity 1 per row (quantityUsed 1). The line-item count becomes the number of declared needs (2).
Distinct records: product0 and product1 are separate PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK needs; the resolver gives them different SKUs (identity sku), which the line-item / cart-count checks need.
No preferred: the sheet SKUs are not in any scan.
The scan records the username/password on this method (the same sign-in call as every method's).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): this method signs in itself with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/quickOrderRetailUserTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B190/C190). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every signing-in method declares its own need user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium pilot entries T01-T04. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet. The scanner recorded the credential values only on LoginWithAUserAccount, MaximumAndMinimumQuantityValidations and AddMultipleProductsToCart; on the other methods the same two cells (same location, kind and masking) are declared from the test source (every method calls successfullLogin with them).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
